title: Generated attenuation file computes per-zone settings and never emits them
body:
## Summary
generateAttenuationCpp builds zoneInits (one block per zone with its attenuation radius) and never writes it into the file, so ZoneAttenuations is never populated and GetAttenuationForZone always returns nullptr.

## Description
src/lib/audio-codegen.ts:351 assigns zoneInits and eslint reports it unused (351:9 no-unused-vars); the content template has no InitializeZones and the header declares none. The per-zone attenuationRadius edited in the painter therefore never reaches UE through this file. Fixing means adding an initializer to the header and cpp, which changes the sha256 pins in src/__tests__/lib/audio-scene-audition.test.ts:148-149 and the runtime contract in src/lib/audio-runtime-contract.ts:42.

## Flow
- design zones with different attenuation radii
- generate code
- AudioZoneAttenuation.cpp has only the lookup and factory; map stays empty

## Expected impact
Zone attenuation set in the editor would take effect in generated code. Risk: hash pins and the UE-side contract must move together.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality: edited attenuation reaches generated C++
Before: zone blocks emitted: 0 of N (zoneInits unused)
After: N of N after adding an initializer (not built)
Method: simulation: read of the template and lint output, three-zone walk; instrument is the existing audition hash test which must be re-pinned
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract
evidence: eslint: audio-codegen.ts 351:9 'zoneInits' is assigned a value but never used; grep zoneInits across src: only audio-codegen.ts:351

title: The 'Within tolerance.' sentinel is a string literal shared by the engine and the view
body:
## Summary
The engine returns the literal 'Within tolerance.' as a nerfSuggestion at three sites and the view compares against the same literal at two; editing either side silently makes every row show a nerf hint.

## Description
src/lib/combat/simulation-engine.ts:860,895,908 produce it; ThreatBreakdownPanel.tsx:43 and :126 test it. The engine is outside this context, so the fix (export a constant or return null) crosses a seam.

## Flow
- export NO_NERF_NEEDED from the engine
- use it at the five sites
- add a test that the engine's no-op suggestion equals the constant

## Expected impact
Removes a silent coupling. Low urgency until wording changes.

## Evaluation
Claim: other: remove a duplicated magic string
Before: literal occurrences: 5 across 2 files
After: 1 definition, 5 uses
Method: probe: grep
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Advanced panels vanish silently when a run produced nothing to show
body:
## Summary
ThreatBreakdownPanel returns null when totalDamageTaken is 0 and there are no sources, AbilityHeatmap returns null for an empty heatmap and DistributionChart for empty buckets, so Advanced mode shows blank space with no statement of why.

## Description
ThreatBreakdownPanel.tsx:12, AbilityHeatmap.tsx:13, DistributionChart.tsx:13. A zero-ability or zero-damage run is indistinguishable from a render bug. Alerts shows 'Encounter Balanced' for such a run (AlertsSection.tsx:7).

## Flow
- clear all abilities and run
- Advanced mode
- three panels absent, 'Encounter Balanced' shown

## Expected impact
An explicit 'no damage recorded' line per panel; also consider blocking a zero-ability run.

## Evaluation
Claim: user: designed empty state
Before: panels that render nothing on an empty run: 3
After: 3 panels with an explanatory empty state (not built)
Method: simulation: three walked cases (no abilities, no enemies hit, empty buckets)
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Distribution chart values are hover-only and the chart has no text alternative
body:
## Summary
DistributionChart shows bucket values in a tooltip that is hidden except on mouse hover and the bars are plain divs, so keyboard, touch and screen-reader users get no values; only p50 and p95 markers exist and they are aria-hidden.

## Description
DistributionChart.tsx:131 'hidden group-hover:block'; PercentileMarker has aria-hidden. Needs a role=img summary (title, range, p50, p95) or a visually-hidden table.

## Flow
- tab to the chart
- nothing focusable
- values unreachable without a mouse

## Expected impact
Three charts become readable by AT. Needs a design choice (summary text vs table).

## Evaluation
Claim: user: non-pointer access to chart values
Before: focusable or labelled chart elements: 0
After: labelled summary on each of 3 charts (not built)
Method: simulation: DOM walk of the three charts
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: GET /api/audio-gen walks the whole audio directory with statSync on every call
body:
## Summary
Every GET /api/audio-gen (Library mount and refresh, Sound Forge mount and after each run, the property panel's set library) runs getDiskFootprint, a synchronous recursive readdir+stat over every clip, on the request path.

## Description
src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:147 and src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:274-291. Cost grows linearly with clips and blocks the event loop; the byte total is only displayed in the Library sidebar. Options: a size column on audio_assets (sum in SQL), or a short-TTL cache invalidated by POST/DELETE.

## Flow
- measure GET with 5k clips
- move bytes into the DB or cache with invalidation

## Expected impact
Faster library loads at scale. Needs a schema change or invalidation design, so not built.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance: GET latency independent of clip count
Before: statSync calls per GET = clip count (e.g. 1 per file)
After: 0 per GET with a size column (not built)
Method: simulation: call-site count; instrument (timing on a seeded 5k-file dir) not built
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:274 getDiskFootprint; src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:147; callers: AudioLibraryPanel.tsx:98, SoundForgePanel.tsx:64, AudioPropertyPanel/useAudioSetLibrary.ts:51

title: next.config.ts DEV_INSPECT loader uses process.cwd() while the rest pins to __dirname
body:
## Summary
The root is deliberately pinned to __dirname (comment at lines 43-50) because cwd inference is unreliable, but the DEV_INSPECT branch builds the loader path and rootDir from process.cwd().

## Description
next.config.ts:69-75. Launching dev from another directory breaks the loader path; low risk since the flag is opt-in. Not verifiable without running the dev server, which the brief forbids.

## Flow
- swap process.cwd() for __dirname in both places
- run npm run dev:inspect from the repo root and a parent

## Expected impact
Consistent root handling for the opt-in inspector.

## Evaluation
Claim: other: consistency
Before: uses of process.cwd() in next.config.ts: 2
After: 0
Method: simulation: read only (dev server not allowed)
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Expose healingMul in TUNING_SLIDERS and COMBAT_METRICS glossary
body:
## Summary
`TuningOverrides` (`src/types/combat-simulator.ts:89`) defines `healingMul: number`, which the combat engine and test fixtures populate, but `TUNING_SLIDERS` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/constants.ts:33-41`) and `COMBAT_METRICS` (`src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts:102-144`) omit `healingMul`.

## Description
`TuningOverrides` has 8 fields (`playerHealthMul`, `playerDamageMul`, `playerArmorMul`, `enemyHealthMul`, `enemyDamageMul`, `critMultiplierMul`, `armorEffectivenessWeight`, `healingMul`), but `TUNING_SLIDERS` in `constants.ts:33-41` only renders 7 sliders, omitting `healingMul`. Adding `healingMul` to `TUNING_SLIDERS` requires adding a matching `healingMul` entry in `src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts` (enforced by `src/__tests__/lib/combat/metric-glossary.test.ts`), which is outside `combat-simulator`'s declared `file_paths`.

## Flow
`TUNING_SLIDERS` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/constants.ts:33-41`) -> `TuningSlidersPanel` (`TuningSlidersPanel.tsx:31-38`) -> `MetricLabel` (`src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts:102-144`).

## Expected impact
Allows designers to tune `healingMul` from `TuningSlidersPanel` alongside the other 7 `TuningOverrides` multipliers once `metric-glossary.ts` is updated in tandem.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `TUNING_SLIDERS` has 7 entries while `TuningOverrides` has 8 keys (`healingMul` omitted).
- **Before:** `TUNING_SLIDERS.length === 7` (`healingMul` absent in `constants.ts:33-41` and `src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts:102-144`).
- **After:** Deferred to backlog because updating `src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts` crosses outside `combat-simulator`'s declared `file_paths`.
- **Method:** `inspect`
- **Result:** `open`
- **Gate:** `scope`
